scientific_integrity: Universal proof is analytic. Exact rational finite enumeration provides a consistency check, not a proof for arbitrarily many agents. The initiating source supplies the model, the no-cross structural lemma for distinct locations, and an efficient algorithm for a selected PNE; only this additional sharp symmetric-special-case theorem is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only two predetermined facilities and two equally sized colocated groups, with identical positive opening costs and metric unit travel costs. Ordinary pure Nash equilibria only. No independently performed external scientific audit. Residual risk of a previously unpublished, unindexed, or incompletely inspected equivalent special case.
title: A sharp two-village equilibrium and inefficiency phase diagram for fair-cost-sharing facilities
